technical_and_design_decisions: Leverage Spring Kafka and Spring Cloud Stream Kafka Binder abstractions for implementing message ACK, concurrency, compression, and batching features.
Implement request-reply semantics via dedicated Kafka topics using standard Spring Kafka ReplyingKafkaTemplate / binder requestor-replier patterns.
Utilize Testcontainers with Apache Kafka for end-to-end CI acceptance testing.
Stream Sqoop execution logs by wrapping the external Process standard output and standard error streams into SLF4J / application log appenders.
Support Sqoop incremental data loading by standardizing parameter mapping for standard Sqoop flags (--incremental, --check-column, --last-value).
assumptions: Target environment runs on Java 17+ and Spring Framework 6.0+ compatible baseline.
The CI pipeline environment supports running Docker containers or embedded Kafka instances for acceptance test execution.
Sqoop command-line client or binary dependencies are accessible in the runtime environment where Sqoop tasks execute.
The software developer possesses existing proficiency with Spring Framework, Spring Cloud Stream/Kafka, and Sqoop integration.

activities.activity_description: Define configuration models for Kafka binder options (ACK, batching, compression, concurrency, request-reply) and design Sqoop lifecycle control and log streaming components.
Configure Kafka test containers / embedded test broker in the CI suite and create automated acceptance test cases to validate message bus features on every build.

activities.activity_name: Kafka Concurrency, Compression, & ACK Configuration (U2, U3)
activities.activity_description: Implement global configuration defaults and per-deployment overrides for Kafka concurrency, compression algorithms (gzip, snappy, lz4, zstd), and message acknowledgement modes.
Implement bindRequestor and bindReplier features to support asynchronous request-reply messaging patterns over Kafka topic pairs.
Implement container listener batching support and configuration properties to process messages in batches rather than single payloads.

activities.activity_name: Sqoop Job Termination & Incremental Load (U6, U8)
activities.activity_description: Implement functionality to gracefully stop running Sqoop jobs and release resources, and add options for incremental data loading based on check-column and last-value state.
Build log capture mechanisms to intercept Sqoop process standard output/error and stream logs into the central application logging framework.
Perform comprehensive unit, integration, and end-to-end verification across Kafka and Sqoop features, write technical documentation, and finalize PR.
